device_entry.description: 数字示波器是一种电子测试仪器，用于采集、显示和分析电压随时间变化的波形。它通常支持多通道输入，可用于电路调试、时域信号观测、脉冲与噪声分析，以及保存波形数据和仪器设置以便实验记录与重复测试。
device_entry.description_en: A digital oscilloscope is an electronic test instrument used to acquire, display, and analyze voltage waveforms over time. It typically supports multiple input channels and is used for circuit debugging, time-domain signal observation, pulse and noise analysis, and saving waveform data and instrument setups for lab records and repeatable testing.
